headline: Callahan's Passage Yields a Work as Weathered Expanse Boils
war_summary: The line at Callahan's Passage is no longer whole. That sector, counted all Warden at the earlier filing, now returns nine works of ten, one post gone to no-man's-land, though the fighting there grinds on — four events in two hours, twenty across the day, and some 473 Colonial against 373 Warden casualties in the last two hours alone. The sharper change lies in the Weathered Expanse, which has broken its quiet: six events in two hours and fifty-seven across the day, chiefly at Wightwalk and Crow's Nest, with roughly 1,551 Colonial and 2,321 Warden casualties in the past two hours; two works stand Warden, five Colonial, two unclaimed. Kuura Strand is the newest storm centre, twelve events in two hours about Martti and Faden Point, all six works yet Warden. Palantine Berm, the busiest desk a short while ago, is silent this watch. Stlican Shelf has gone seven Colonial to two Warden. Across 436 counted works the Colonials hold 308, the Wardens 121, seven unclaimed. No victory is declared on this, the 530th day; thirty-four victory towns remain the mark.
